subject: Re: OliveAI — proposal for 3-year prepay with staggered ramp
messages:
From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@olive.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@olive.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp

Marcus —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We discussed an internal budget path that would let us prepay for a 3-year commitment, but we need the pricing to reflect our expected ramp. Proposed consumption split: Year 1 = 50% of committed units, Year 2 = 30%, Year 3 = 20%. That gets us to a multi-year commitment while protecting the business early on.

Given that structure, procurement is asking whether Redwood can offer a 17.5–19% term discount off list for the prepaid commitment (we quoted them the standard 12% 3yr earlier). Also need clarity on ramp credits, invoice schedule (we prefer split annual invoicing), and whether we can get a 60-day SLA credit for downtime in year 1 while we're integrating.

Attached is a draft SOW (SOW_OliveAI_3yr_v1.pdf) and our procurement checklist. Happy to hop on a quick call to walk through.

Samuel Ortiz
Head of Platform
OliveAI

Attachment: SOW_OliveAI_3yr_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@olive.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp

Samuel —

Appreciate the clear ramp breakdown. I can work with procurement on split annual invoicing and confirm the SLA credit ask with our ops team. For the term discount: I need to route this to pricing/finance for an exception — copying Aditya and Neha to start the approval thread.

Next steps:
- Marcus: share the SOW + pricing workbook (attached)
- Aditya: quick pricing review and an initial band we can commit to
- Neha: sign-off threshold / escalation if >15%

Can we target a decision by Friday so procurement can finish internal approvals?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: pricing_workbook_olive.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp (pricing take)

Marcus / Neha —

Read the SOW and the workbook. Baseline economics: with the 3yr prepay and total committed units they outlined, 12% is inline with our standard tiering. If we accept a Year1-heavy ramp (50% upfront), we can give room for an additional uplift to 15% total as a standard concession — that assumes annual invoicing and no change to refund/true-up terms.

If procurement is pushing for ~18%, that crosses my approval band and will require a finance discount exception and probably a small one-time onboarding credit to compensate cost in year 1. I'd recommend:
- Offer: 15% term discount as the baseline (fast approval)
- Escalation ask: up to 18% conditional on a signed 3yr prepay, annual invoicing, and acceptance of our standard non-refundable prepay clause + a one-time onboarding credit capped at $25k

If we go above 15% we should get Neha's sign-off.

-Aditya
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp (approval path)

Thanks Aditya — good analysis. I'm comfortable approving up to 18% under the conditions you outlined: signed 3yr prepay, annual invoicing (we'll split invoice dates: immediate Year 1 charged at execution, Year 2 on anniversary, Year 3 on second anniversary), and a $25k cap on onboarding credits. Also require that the SLA credit request be handled via our standard SLA credit policy (won't be an additional monetary discount).

One more ask: include a rollback clause if usage materially exceeds the committed band (>120% in any year) to allow us to re-evaluate cost or provide unblock credits. Add this to SOW.

Neha Kapoor
VP, Commercial Operations

[Internal instruction: Marcus, please update the SOW and send the redline to contracts. Finance will need the pricing_workbook_olive.xlsx in the deal folder.]
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@olive.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, contracts@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp — proposed terms

Samuel —

Thanks for the patience. We can agree to the 3-year prepaid structure with the staggered ramp you requested. Summary of agreed commercial terms:
- Term: 36 months prepaid, committed units per SOW
- Ramp split: Year1 50% / Year2 30% / Year3 20%
- Term discount: 18% off list (conditional)
- Conditions for 18%: signed 3yr prepay, annual invoicing (Year1 charged at execution, Year2 on each anniversary), acceptance of standard non-refundable prepay clause, and onboarding credit capped at $25,000.
- SLA credit: will follow Redwood standard SLA credit policy (operations will confirm process) — not an additional monetary discount.
- Rollback clause: if usage >120% of committed units in any single year, Redwood reserves the right to re-evaluate pricing or provide counterbalancing credits; to be detailed in SOW.

I've attached the redlined SOW and a pricing workbook reflecting the 18% scenario. Please confirm acceptance and we'll send the DocuSign envelope for signature.

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_OliveAI_3yr_v2.pdf, pricing_workbook_olive.xlsx, redwood_terms_redline.docx
From: Samuel Ortiz <samuel@olive.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@olive.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: 3-year prepay with staggered ramp — acceptance pending signature

Marcus —

This aligns with what procurement needed. We accept the conditional 18% with the onboarding credit cap and the rollback clause as written — I'll route the redlined SOW to our legal and procurement for final review. Expect us to sign the DocuSign envelope next week pending a brief legal clarification on the rollback trigger language.

Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Sam
Samuel Ortiz
Head of Platform, OliveAI

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/olivedoc/3yr-prepay
